description_for_human: Swap and provide liquidity on JuiceSwap — the DEX on Citrea (Bitcoin ZK rollup).
description_for_model: JuiceSwap is a Uniswap V2/V3 fork on Citrea (Bitcoin ZK rollup, chainIds 4114 mainnet, 5115 testnet). Use the public REST API at https://ponder.juiceswap.com to read on-chain state: token catalogue, V3 positions per wallet, swap activity per wallet, and V2 pool statistics. All endpoints are read-only and require no authentication. The web interface is at https://bapp.juiceswap.com.
